item.text:
Replaced the [UserProfile placeholder](/workspace/app/UserProfile.tsx:1) with an async server component. It fetches `/api/users/profile`, displays the user’s name and email, and shows a fallback message if the request fails. The dashboard already renders the component.

TypeScript checking and the production build passed. This repository has no `/api/users/profile` route, so profile data will appear once that endpoint is available.
